name: אֲמִתַּי
summary: The father of Jonah the prophet, of Gath-hepher in Zebulun (2Ki 14:25; Jon 1:1). The name is אֱמֶת “truth, faithfulness” with the ending -ay, as in its suffixed forms אֲמִתּוֹ, אֲמִתְּךָ (Gen 24:27; Psa 54:7): “my truth” or “true”.

evidence.note: “The word of Yahweh came to Jonah the son of אֲמִתַּי.”
“By his servant Jonah the son of אֲמִתַּי, the prophet, who was of Gath-hepher.”
“His kindness וַאֲמִתּוֹ”: the noun with a suffix, the stem the name is built on.

note: Takes a.dy.ar (2 tokens). The zero-token cross-reference a.ea.an (“אֲמִתַּי see אמן”) is left unassigned.
